# Generated by tools/run-filter-matrix.py.
@@@ doc empty
{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{},"blocks":[]}
@@@ doc small
{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}
@@@ filter run-filter-lua empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function keys(value)
  local names = {}
  for key in pairs(value) do names[#names + 1] = key end
  return table.concat(names, ',')
end
local function with_files(callback)
  return P.system.with_temporary_directory('lua-wave8b', callback)
end
local function write(path, data)
  local handle = assert(io.open(path, 'wb'))
  assert(handle:write(data))
  assert(handle:close())
end
local function run(document)
local U=P.utils
local function run_filter(source, env)
  return with_files(function(dir)
    local path=dir..'/filter.lua'
    write(path,source)
    return U.run_lua_filter(document,path,env)
  end)
end
  probe('U.run_lua_filter()', function() return U.run_lua_filter() end)
  probe('U.run_lua_filter({})', function() return U.run_lua_filter({}) end)
  probe('U.run_lua_filter(document)', function() return U.run_lua_filter(document) end)
  probe('U.run_lua_filter(document, {})', function() return U.run_lua_filter(document, {}) end)
  probe('U.run_lua_filter(document, \039missing.lua\039, true)', function() return U.run_lua_filter(document, 'missing.lua', true) end)
  probe('U.run_lua_filter(document, \039wave8b-missing.lua\039)', function() return U.run_lua_filter(document, 'wave8b-missing.lua') end)
  probe('return list', function() local d=run_filter("return {{Pandoc=function(d) d.blocks:insert(pandoc.Para'one');return d end},{Str=function(s) s.text=s.text:upper();return s end}}"); return d.blocks,document.blocks end)
  probe('global functions', function() return run_filter("function Pandoc(d) d.blocks:insert(pandoc.Para(FORMAT..':'..PANDOC_SCRIPT_FILE)); return d end").blocks end)
  probe('explicit environment', function() local env={P=P,token='local'}
          local out=run_filter("return {Pandoc=function(d) d.blocks:insert(P.Para(token)); return d end}",env)
          return out.blocks,env.pandoc,env._G end)
  probe('environment writes', function() local env={token='before'}
          run_filter("token = 'after'; return {}",env)
          return env.token end)
  probe('no global fallback', function() return run_filter("return {Pandoc=function(d) if tostring then d.blocks={} end; return d end}",{}).blocks end)
  probe('bad result', function() return run_filter('return 42') end)
  probe('runtime error', function() local ok,err=pcall(run_filter,"error('nested failure')")
          local text=tostring(err)
          return ok,text:find('nested failure',1,true)~=nil,text:find('stack traceback',1,true)~=nil end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end
@@@ filter run-filter-json empty small

local function probe(label, fn)

local function run(document)
local U=P.utils
  probe('U.run_json_filter()', function() return U.run_json_filter() end)
  probe('U.run_json_filter({})', function() return U.run_json_filter({}) end)
  probe('U.run_json_filter(document)', function() return U.run_json_filter(document) end)
  probe('U.run_json_filter(document,{})', function() return U.run_json_filter(document,{}) end)
  probe('U.run_json_filter(document,\039cat\039,false)', function() return U.run_json_filter(document,'cat',false) end)
  probe('U.run_json_filter(document,\039cat\039,{false})', function() return U.run_json_filter(document,'cat',{false}) end)
  probe('U.run_json_filter(document,\039cat\039,{})', function() return U.run_json_filter(document,'cat',{}) end)
  probe('nil FORMAT', function() local saved=FORMAT; FORMAT=nil; local ok,err=pcall(U.run_json_filter,document,'cat'); FORMAT=saved; return ok,tostring(err) end)
  probe('default FORMAT', function() local ok,err=pcall(U.run_json_filter,document,'echo'); return ok,tostring(err):find(FORMAT,1,true)~=nil end)
  probe('stringified number arguments', function() local ok,err=pcall(U.run_json_filter,document,'echo',{'tag',123}); return ok,tostring(err):find('tag 123',1,true)~=nil end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end
@@@ filter run-filter-references empty small

local function probe(label, fn)

  local parts = {}

local function run(document)
local U=P.utils
local ref={id='a', type='book', volume='12', title=P.Inlines{P.Str'A',P.Space(),P.Emph'Title'},
  author={{family='Dijk',given='Jan',['dropping-particle']='de',['non-dropping-particle']='van',
    suffix='Sr.',['comma-suffix']=true,['static-ordering']=true},{literal='Team'}},
  issued={literal='Spring',circa=true,season='2'},
  accessed={['date-parts']={{'2000','1'},{'2002','3'}},circa=true},
  ['custom-field']='custom'}
local refs={ref,{id='b',type='article-journal',title='Other'},{title='No id'}}
local reference_doc=P.Pandoc({P.Para{P.Cite('a',{P.Citation('a','NormalCitation')})}},
  {references=refs})
local uncited=P.Pandoc({}, {references=refs})
local all=P.Pandoc({}, {references=refs,nocite=P.Inlines{P.Cite('@*',{P.Citation('*','NormalCitation')})}})
  probe('U.references()', function() return U.references() end)
  probe('U.references(nil)', function() return U.references(nil) end)
  probe('U.references({})', function() return U.references({}) end)
  probe('U.references(document)', function() return U.references(document) end)
  probe('U.references(reference_doc)', function() return U.references(reference_doc) end)
  probe('U.references(uncited)', function() return U.references(uncited) end)
  probe('U.references(all)', function() return U.references(all) end)
  probe('shape', function() local r=U.references(reference_doc)[1]; return type(r.id),type(r.type),P.utils.type(r.volume),P.utils.type(r.author),P.utils.type(r.issued['date-parts']),P.utils.type(r.accessed['date-parts'][1]) end)
  probe('CSL JSON bibliography', function() return with_files(function(dir)
          local path=dir..'/references.json'
          write(path,'[{"id":"a","type":"book","title":"A Book","volume":12,"URL":"https://example.com"}]')
          return U.references(P.Pandoc(reference_doc.blocks,{bibliography=path}))
        end) end)
  probe('missing bibliography', function() return U.references(P.Pandoc(reference_doc.blocks,{bibliography='wave8b-missing.bib'})) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end
